title: Gambler
desc: Inspector Dayashanker, though lazy, accidentally uncovers a big criminal plot and suddenly becomes a hero in his department. But angry gangsters make his life a nightmare.

title: Kyon Ho Gaya Na
desc: Diya and Arjun clash over love and marriage. But as they spend time together, their differences fade and love blossoms between them.

title: Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas
desc: Saher, a video blogger, travels alone to expose Karan, a tourism company owner she believes is a fraud. What begins with clash and mistrust slowly turns into love.

title: Army
desc: After army officer Arjun is brutally killed by gangster Naagraj, his wife Geeta vows revenge and forms a group of determined young men to bring Naagraj down.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.

title: Traffic Signal
desc: Silsila, a street-smart young man who manages various trades at a Mumbai traffic signal, sees his life crumble when he unknowingly helps execute a murder.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Goodbye
desc: A family unravels after the sudden death of the mother. As the children rush home for her final rites, clashing opinions ignite tensions, exposing deep-rooted conflicts.

title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth are deeply in love, but her brother Ganpat, a gangster, disapproves of their relationship and plots to kill Siddharth.

title: Haan Maine Bhi Pyar Kiya
desc: Shiv and Pooja's marriage shatters when she discovers his infidelity. Their lives take a new turn when Raj, a film star, enters Pooja's life.

title: Dil Juunglee
desc: Koroli, an English teacher and business tycoon's daughter, unexpectedly falls for Sumit, an aspiring Bollywood actor who enrolls in her class to win her heart.

title: Gangaajal
desc: IPS Amit Kumar, an honest cop, is posted to a crime-ridden town. He battles ruthless criminals, crooked officers, and shady politicians to restore law and justice.

title: Rustom
desc: Rustom is a navy officer happily married to Cynthia. When he finds out she's cheating with his friend Vikram, things turn tragic, and Rustom is blamed for murder.

title: Tehran
desc: After a 2012 Delhi bombing, officer RK's Tehran mission turns deadly when Iran targets him and India abandons him in his quest to expose the truth.

title: Khamoshiyan
desc: Kabir, a struggling writer seeking inspiration in Kashmir, stays at a mysterious guest house and falls for Meera, its owner, unaware she is hiding a dark secret.

title: Turtle
desc: Ramkaran struggles to extract water in a drought-hit village. As thirst grows, villagers search for desperate solutions, revealing the harsh realities of survival and hope.
